description: Defines threading primitives, thread priorities, thread IDs, thread creation, management, and thread-local storage for the Starboard platform abstraction layer.

methods.name: SbThreadGetId
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the currently executing thread.

methods.name: SbThreadSetPriority
methods.description: Sets the thread priority of the current thread (API version >= 16).

methods.name: SbThreadGetPriority
methods.description: Gets the thread priority of the current thread (API version >= 16).

methods.name: SbThreadCreate
methods.description: Creates a new thread with specified parameters.

methods.name: SbThreadJoin
methods.description: Joins a thread, blocking until it exits.

methods.name: SbThreadDetach
methods.description: Detaches a thread, preventing it from being joined.

methods.name: SbThreadYield
methods.description: Yields execution of the current thread.

methods.name: SbThreadSleep
methods.description: Sleeps the current thread for a specified duration.

methods.name: SbThreadGetCurrent
methods.description: Returns the handle of the current thread.

methods.name: SbThreadIsEqual
methods.description: Checks if two thread handles refer to the same thread.

methods.name: SbThreadGetName
methods.description: Retrieves the debug name of the current thread.

methods.name: SbThreadSetName
methods.description: Sets the debug name of the current thread.

methods.name: SbThreadCreateLocalKey
methods.description: Creates a new thread-local storage key.

methods.name: SbThreadDestroyLocalKey
methods.description: Destroys a thread-local storage key.

methods.name: SbThreadGetLocalValue
methods.description: Gets the thread-local value for a key.

methods.name: SbThreadSetLocalValue
methods.description: Sets the thread-local value for a key.

methods.name: SbThreadContextGetPointer
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer property from a thread context.

methods.name: SbThreadSamplerCreate
methods.description: Creates a thread sampler for profiling or debugging.

methods.name: SbThreadSamplerDestroy
methods.description: Destroys a thread sampler.

methods.name: SbThreadSamplerFreeze
methods.description: Freezes a thread for sampling.

methods.name: SbThreadSamplerThaw
methods.description: Resumes a frozen thread.

methods.name: SbThreadIsSupported
methods.description: Checks if thread sampling is supported on the platform.
